feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 June 2026 11:14am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 30 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Shallow area of low pressure and associated frontal zone affecting much of the British Isles gradually clearing as a ridge of high pressure approaches from the west.


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the west at first, veering west or southwest 2 to 4 this evening, veering northwest 3 to 5 tonight, backing west 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, but moderate in the west at first.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle soon becoming isolated showers, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, backing south or southwest 5 to 7 later in the afternoon, veering west or northwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming mainly moderate and occasionally rough later.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then occasional rain or drizzle until later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
